top_comments.text: How does it compare to FluidVoice? Fluid's transcription is great. It uses Nvidia parakeet model. But it's AI cleanup is really bad, even when using a capable model like GPT 5.6 Luna from Openrouter. The AI cleanup is very unreliable. How is FreeFlow in that regard?
